data_fields.name: level_gap_roll_bonus
data_fields.donor_constant: LevelDifferenceRollBonus (rule value, not read); capped 2.0, floored 0.1

data_fields.name: crit_damage_multiplier
data_fields.donor_constant: 170 + GetCritDmgMod, floor 100, applied as damage x mod / 100

best_idea: A swing is a fixed sequence of single percent checks (avoid ladder, then a hit test, then a crit die), and damage comes from one offense-versus-mitigation ratio roll on a 20-step table rather than a formula.
decision_why: Take the 20-step ratio table and the one-roll-per-check order into the duel step (easy to read in a replay and to tune per zone); drop the skill-scaled divisors and heroic stats (EverQuest stats we do not have); keep parry and block inside row 3's guard.
acceptance: A seeded server test runs 100,000 swings at equal offense and mitigation; the damage histogram equals an independent recount of the 20-step table; a crit happens only when the die falls under the DEX threshold; each avoided swing reports exactly one avoidance reason.
